goal: Turn an idea typed in a browser tab into a full Prism model, proved by Lean and shared as one self-verifying holo, with no sign-in and no model outside Foundry.
title: Prism AI Foundry

stakeholders.name: App builder
stakeholders.text: Types an idea, watches Foundry extrapolate the whole app, previews it, has Lean prove it and publishes it.

stakeholders.name: App visitor
stakeholders.text: Opens a published app by its address and uses it, trusting what its badge says.

stakeholders.name: Verifier
stakeholders.text: Replays a published holo and its proofs before trusting an answer.

stakeholders.name: Maintainer
stakeholders.text: Changes Foundry itself, a person or an agent, and needs every change checked once and only where it reaches.

concerns.name: Whole model from one idea
concerns.text: One idea becomes every facet of a Prism model: behavior, architecture, design, features, security, quality and compliance.

concerns.name: Own models only
concerns.text: An idea is answered by Foundry's own language and reasoning in the tab; Prism R4 refuses a route to any other model.

concerns.name: No sign-in
concerns.text: Foundry is usable at once: the Prism id is kept in the browser, and linking or recovering it never stands between the person and the app.

concerns.name: Honest proof status
concerns.text: An app is never shown as proved without a Lean proof, never published unproved, and every edit returns it to drafting.

concerns.name: Consent before effects
concerns.text: No origin reaches the network, a model or storage without a grant, and a denial always wins.

concerns.name: Responsive studio
concerns.text: Every journey the kernel budgets stays within its budget on a phone.

concerns.name: Accessible on any screen
concerns.text: Layout, motion and tap targets follow the kernel's experience rules on narrow and wide screens.

concerns.name: Private drafts and keys
concerns.text: Draft specs, chats and keys stay in the browser's storage unless the builder publishes them.

concerns.name: Integrity of published apps
concerns.text: What a visitor runs is the exact holo whose proofs were checked, named by the address of its contents.

concerns.name: Only what changed is redone
concerns.text: A proof, a build or a check is reused for identical inputs and redone in full for anything else.

components.name: Browser
components.text: The builder's or visitor's web browser, which runs the studio and every app in a tab.

components.name: Studio
components.text: The renderer's screens and the host under them: home, chat, preview, code, publish, apps, library and settings, run in the tab.

components.name: Prism frame
components.text: The bar every Prism app opens in, which keeps the visitor's Prism id, stitch's, in this browser.

components.name: Origin kernel worker
components.text: The service worker that serves the verified shell closure and asks the kernel before any origin uses an effect.

components.name: Foundry kernel guest
components.text: The Core-Wasm guest built from app/src: build phase, effect gate, budgets, rules and the admission protocols.

components.name: Model in Prism
components.text: Foundry's own language and reasoning: the on-device model, run from weights read back by their address, under Prism R4.

components.name: Prism builder
components.text: Writes every facet of an app's Prism model from one prism/prompt/1, the same projector that writes Foundry's own.

components.name: Device store
components.text: The browser's storage of projects, snapshots, chats, settings and sealed answers.

components.name: Lean checker
components.text: The Lean checker that proves an app's theorems and returns an attestation.

components.name: GitHub
components.text: The repository a builder publishes an app's source to, after approving each write.

components.name: Pages host
components.text: Serves the studio, the frame and published apps from GitHub Pages.

components.name: Holo viewer
components.text: holo.html, which opens a published holo on any device after its bytes re-derive to their address.

components.name: Prism SDK
components.text: prismpm and lexlean in the image prismpm.lock pins, which verify the kernel and build its holo.

features.name: Build phase
features.text: Each app moves drafting, proving, proved, published only as the kernel judges, and every edit returns it to drafting.

features.name: Effect gate
features.text: No origin fetches, infers or stores without a grant record, and a denial wins.

features.name: Experience budgets
features.text: Every journey the kernel budgets is measured and judged within or over its budget.

features.name: Experience rules
features.text: Layout, motion, tap targets, recency and model thinking follow the kernel's rules.

features.name: Private telemetry
features.text: A journey's timings stay on the device, are saved only when asked and never reach a model off the device; the loop suggests and the builder adopts.

features.name: Application authority
features.text: Every behavior has one canonical owner, and the authoring boundary checks every generated module without rewriting drift.

features.name: Host boundary
features.text: The host answers the renderer's contracts with typed errors, validates every command before its handler, and answers an unsupported capability as unsupported.

features.name: Project store
features.text: Projects, files, snapshots and imports commit atomically, re-derive to their addresses and refuse stale sources.

features.name: Canonical model
features.text: An app's source is its canonical module: edits, generation and builds go through it, and a model's code is never applied.

features.name: Chat
features.text: Build, Ask and Plan turns queue, run and recover through the guest, with modes and preferences stored atomically.

features.name: Own language and reasoning
features.text: Prism R4 decides every answer: only the model in Prism, from weights read back by their address, answers, and no route leaves the tab.

features.name: Idea routing
features.text: An idea is routed onto ranked, typed features and Prism admits the proposal; a finite vocabulary discovers catalog apps only after review.

features.name: Full model extrapolation
features.text: The builder writes every facet of the app's Prism model from the routed idea, and the published commit carries every facet.

features.name: Feature composition
features.text: Features compose only with their exact dependencies through the pinned, replayed guest.

features.name: Event admission
features.text: Typed events bind to the current composition, generation and sequence, cross a bounded wire and stay pending until acknowledged.

features.name: Builds
features.text: Previews and portable builds run under guest-admitted work, from one verified snapshot and approved modules, in bounded workers.

features.name: Versions and preview
features.text: Version history keeps content identity; a preview restores exact source, starts only as allowed and sends source only under permission.

features.name: Stateful apps
features.text: A stateful app's transitions are guest-admitted, recover atomically and project consent-sensitive output.

features.name: Proof
features.text: A verdict is decided by the guest from what the tab derived, a theorem proved on the same declarations is reused, and local obligations hold on every request.

features.name: Publication
features.text: A proved app is published as a holo under its exact archive identity, with a cover from its preview and GitHub writes only on approval.

features.name: Shell integrity
features.text: The worker activates only a verified shell closure; the editor, compiler, stylesheet and host bundle load from locked bytes; the kernel's owner is ready before it answers.

features.name: Libraries and settings
features.text: Prompts, themes and settings persist atomically, and a new project takes the selected theme.

features.name: Windows and tools
features.text: Windows coordinate focus and interests, and Foundry's tools stay reachable on every width.

features.name: Release integration
features.text: Current main integrates every protocol, only superseded pull request runs are cancelled, and every main and release run keeps its full acceptance.

journeys.name: Idea to a proved app
journeys.outcome: An idea typed on Home becomes a previewed app whose every facet is defined and whose theorems Lean proved.

journeys.name: Publish an app
journeys.outcome: A proved app is published as a holo under its address.

journeys.name: Return to an app
journeys.outcome: An app made earlier is found, opened, read and changed.

journeys.name: Shape the studio
journeys.outcome: Prompts, themes and settings are kept for the next app.

journeys.name: Use a published app
journeys.outcome: A published app opens and runs from its address.

journeys.name: Replay a holo
journeys.outcome: The holo's answers and proofs are checked before an answer is trusted.

journeys.name: Change Foundry
journeys.outcome: A change is checked once, only where it reaches, and Foundry's model stays complete.

assets.name: Project source
assets.text: The chat, specs, modules and snapshots of each project.

assets.name: Published holo
assets.text: The app file a visitor opens, with its proofs and acceptance vectors.

assets.name: Kernel guest
assets.text: The guest the studio asks before every phase change and effect.

assets.name: Proof status
assets.text: The phase and attestation the studio shows for an app.

assets.name: Model answer
assets.text: What Foundry's own model answers for one turn, before it is shown or applied.

threats.name: Unproved app shown as proved
threats.text: The studio shows proved, or publishes, an app whose theorems Lean has not checked.

control.name: Kernel build phase
control.text: Only an attestation in the proving phase answers proved, only a proved app publishes, and every edit returns to drafting.

threats.name: Ungranted network use
threats.text: A preview or a published app fetches, infers or stores without a grant.

control.name: Kernel effect gate
control.text: The origin kernel worker asks the guest before every effect; no record admits only Forge without fetch, and outside Forge needs a grant.

threats.name: Denied grant ignored
threats.text: An effect the builder denied is used because another record grants it.

control.name: Denial wins
control.text: A denied record is refused whatever else it grants.

threats.name: Leaked provider key
threats.text: A provider key is sent anywhere but its own provider, or read by an app.

control.name: Private provider credentials
control.text: Keys stay in the studio's own storage, are sent only to the provider they belong to, and are never in a preview or holo.

evidence.reference: FA-47 private-provider-credentials, cargo test in just vv
FA-16 provider-key-validation, cargo test in just vv

threats.name: Inference without consent
threats.text: Chat text is sent to a cloud model the builder did not approve for this request.

control.name: Per-request inference consent
control.text: Cloud inference needs disclosure and approval for each request, with cancellation before and after it is sent.

evidence.reference: FA-34 inference-consent, cargo test in just vv

threats.name: Draft seen by the hosted checker
threats.text: Proving a draft sends its spec to the hosted checker.
threats.accepted: Lean does not run in the tab yet; the checker sees only the spec being proved, and in-tab checking (PR 155) removes the exposure.

threats.name: Substituted kernel guest
threats.text: The studio runs a kernel other than the one verified from app/src.

control.name: Pinned kernel
control.text: KERNEL_REV pins the verified guest, which replays every acceptance vector before it answers.

evidence.reference: prismpm verify in the SDK image prismpm.lock pins

threats.name: Substituted holo
threats.text: A file other than the published, proved app is served under its address.

control.name: Content-addressed publication
control.text: Publication needs the exact canonical archive identity and complete runtime acceptance.

evidence.reference: FA-05 publication-identity, cargo test in just vv

threats.name: Stale proof reused
threats.text: A proof is reused for declarations or a toolchain other than the ones Lean checked.

control.name: Proof reuse by exact inputs
control.text: A proof is reused only under an address covering the theorem, every declaration it reaches and the exact toolchain.

evidence.reference: FA-85 proof-reuse, cargo test in just vv

threats.name: Substituted host
threats.text: Something other than the repository's Pages serves the studio.
threats.accepted: A page cannot defend against its own host; the holo carries its address and acceptance vectors, so a visitor can replay it elsewhere.

threats.name: Idea sent to a remote model
threats.text: The idea, or a chat turn, is sent to a model outside the tab.

control.name: Prism R4 route
control.text: R4 decides every turn before its request is made; Foundry grants no route, so a routed request is refused and the mode never mixes.

evidence.reference: FA-87 prism-r4-route, cargo test in just vv

threats.name: Unverified weights answer
threats.text: An answer is shown from weights or an engine whose bytes do not have their address.

control.name: Prism R4 bytes
control.text: R4 shows a device answer only when the weights were read back by their image address and the engine's bytes have theirs.

threats.name: Answer shown past the boundary
threats.text: An answer is applied to the app although the Boundary did not allow it.

control.name: Prism R4 boundary
control.text: Nothing is shown without the Boundary's allow.

threats.name: Effect without a decision
threats.text: The studio changes the project or the network without the kernel's answer.

threats.name: Altered project record
threats.text: A stored project, snapshot or chat is changed outside the studio's own edits.

control.name: Validated snapshot restore
control.text: A snapshot restores only after every object it references is validated, and files and the main reference are replaced atomically.

evidence.reference: FA-08 snapshot-restore, cargo test in just vv

threats.name: Holo altered on its way
threats.text: The holo is changed between the host and the viewer.

quality.text: Every acceptance vector of the kernel guest replays in the compiled guest.
quality.measureText: Acceptance vectors whose replay differs from the model.

quality.text: Every FK theorem is checked by the Lean kernel in prismpm verify.
quality.measureText: FK rows without a checked theorem.

quality.requirement: The idea stays in the tab
quality.text: No chat turn's request leaves the tab: R4 refuses every route before it is made.
quality.measureText: Chat turns whose request reaches a model outside the tab.

quality.text: Every IPC call a screen makes reaches a back-end feature the screen requires.
quality.measureText: Screen calls whose channel no required feature owns, counted by foundry_model.mjs.

quality.text: Every register ID has a scenario and a Rust test that names it.
quality.measureText: Register IDs without a scenario or a test, counted by check-model.

quality.text: Every workflow a push starts filters by path and keys its output by its inputs.
quality.measureText: Workflows without a path filter and a hashFiles key or an exemption, counted by audit-reuse.

surfaces.name: Studio shell
surfaces.text: Foundry opens at once in the tab: the sidebar, the title bar and the Prism frame, with no sign-in and the shell served from its verified closure.

surfaces.name: Home
surfaces.text: One box asks for an idea; Enter starts an app from it, answered by Foundry's own model.

surfaces.name: Chat
surfaces.text: The builder talks the app into shape in Build, Ask or Plan, sees its rules written as they stream and approves each step.

surfaces.name: Preview
surfaces.text: The app runs beside the chat from its spec as the rules arrive, and a stateful app answers presses.

surfaces.name: Proof status
surfaces.text: The app's badge says drafting, proving, proved or published, as the kernel judges, and asks Lean to prove it.

surfaces.name: Code
surfaces.text: The app's canonical module and its projections are read and edited directly.

surfaces.name: Publish
surfaces.text: A proved app is published as a holo under its address, with its cover and, on approval, its source on GitHub.

surfaces.name: Apps
surfaces.text: Every app on this device, with its cover, to open again.

surfaces.name: App details
surfaces.text: One app's name, versions and files, to rename, copy, revert or delete it.

surfaces.name: Library
surfaces.text: Prompts, themes and templates kept on this device for the next app.

surfaces.name: Settings
surfaces.text: Appearance, the chat's defaults and what is kept on this device.

surfaces.name: Holo viewer
surfaces.text: A published app opens on any device after its bytes re-derive to their address, and runs under the effect gate.

surfaces.name: Replay
surfaces.text: The holo's acceptance vectors replay in its guest and its attestation is checked against its address.

surfaces.name: Checks
surfaces.text: just vv in the pinned SDK image, and the pull request checks that run only where a change reaches.

opm.name: Build an app from an idea
opm.text: The studio carries one idea typed in the tab to a published, proved app.

steps.name: Route the idea
steps.text: Prism R4 decides the turn: Foundry's own model answers, and no route leaves the tab.

steps.name: Draft the model
steps.text: The model in Prism extrapolates every facet of the app from the idea.

steps.name: Ask the kernel
steps.text: The guest decides the next build phase, or whether an origin may use an effect.

steps.name: Prove
steps.text: Lean proves the app's theorems and returns an attestation.

steps.name: Publish
steps.text: The proved app is written as a holo and pushed for Pages to serve under its address.
